ct-cap-memory.title: Capacitor memory (Lecture 6, slide 5): the current iS(t) into a 5 F capacitor and the voltage v(t) = (1/C)∫i dt — the voltage grows by the area under the current and keeps its value (5 V) after the current stops

ct-kcl-node.title: KCL at node a (Lecture 2, slide 16): I₁ = 5 A and I₃ = 3 A enter, I₂ = 2 A and IT leave; the dots flowing in and out show that what enters equals what leaves: IT = I₁ − I₂ + I₃ = 6 A
